feed_summary: This release we have three pull requests from jburgess-r7 building out coverage for the identity-boundary issues detailed in Rapid7's Breaking Zimbra Identity Boundaries, Part One research. First up is a new shared mixin, Msf::Exploit::Remote::HTTP::Zimbra , which gives every current and future Zimbra module a common foundation for account/admin SOAP authentication, canonical identity resolution, mailbox-server lookup, and version parsing, allowing future modules to stay focused on the vulnerability instead of re-implementing Zimbra's SOAP plumbing. title: Metasploit Wrap Up: Breaking Zimbra's Identity Boundaries
